valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some a : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = a
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = u1->a
        User <: posts = u1->a
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = a->d
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj i1, i2, u : User |
    some disj p : Photo |
    some disj d : Day {
        User = i1 + i2 + u
        Influencer = i1 + i2
        Photo = p
        Ad = none
        Day = d
        User <: follows = u->i1 + u->i2 + i1->u
        User <: sees = i1->p
        User <: posts = u->p
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = p->d
    }
} for exactly 3 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

consistent:
run PositiveScenario2 {
    some disj a, b : Track |
    some disj s : Signal {
        Track = a + b
        Junction = none
        Signal = s
        Entry = a
        Exit = b
        Semaphore = s
        Speed = none
        Track <: succs = a->b
        Track <: signals = a->s
    }
} for exactly 2 Track, exactly 0 Junction, exactly 1 Signal expect 1

run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj a, b, c : Track |
    some disj s1, s2 : Signal {
        Track = a + b + c
        Junction = none
        Signal = s1 + s2
        Entry = a
        Exit = c
        Semaphore = s1
        Speed = s2
        Track <: succs = a->b + b->c
        Track <: signals = a->s1 + c->s2
    }
} for exactly 3 Track, exactly 0 Junction, exactly 2 Signal expect 1

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj a, b, c : Track |
    some disj s : Signal {
        Track = a + b + c
        Junction = none
        Signal = s
        Entry = a
        Exit = c
        Semaphore = none
        Speed = s
        Track <: succs = a->b + b->a
        Track <: signals = c->s
    }
} for exactly 3 Track, exactly 0 Junction, exactly 1 Signal expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj a, b, c : Track |
    some disj s : Signal {
        Track = a + b + c
        Junction = none
        Signal = s
        Entry = a + b + c
        Exit = c
        Semaphore = s
        Speed = none
        Track <: succs = a->c + b->c
        Track <: signals = a->s
    }
} for exactly 3 Track, exactly 0 Junction, exactly 1 Signal expect 0

previous:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p1, p2 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = none
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = none
        Grade = g1
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1
        Person <: projects = none->none
        Course <: projects = none->none
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 0 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p1, p2, s1 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some x1 : Project |
    some g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = s1
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = x1
        Grade = g1
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s1->c1
        Person <: projects = s1->x1
        Course <: projects = c1->x1
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p1, p2, p3, s1 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2, c3 : Course |
    some x3 : Project |
    some g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + p3 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2 + p3
        Student = s1
        Course = c1 + c2 + c3
        Project = x3
        Grade = g1
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2 + p3->c3
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + p3->c2 + s1->c3
        Person <: projects = s1->x3
        Course <: projects = c3->x3
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 4 Person, exactly 3 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0
